business_summary: Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells mechanical seals, special valves, and other sealed products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Automobile and Construction Machinery Industries, General Industrial Machinery, Semiconductor Industry, Marine Industry, and Aerospace Industry segments. It offers mechanical, gas, aerospace, magnetic fluid vacuum, segmented, stern tube, brush, and lip seals. The company also provides metal gaskets, O-rings, accumulators, actuators, aerospace, bearings, tanks, coupling, joint, valves, filters, metal bellows, thin-walled metal parts, supply systems, hydraulic regeneration systems, and flow meters. It serves oil and gas; construction, agriculture, and transporter; automobiles; energy; aerospace; pulp and paper; housing equipment; food and beverage and pharmaceutical; water and irrigation; refinery and petrochemical; marine; steel; and semiconductor industries. The company was formerly known as Nihon Sealol Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. in June 1978. Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of NOK Group Corporation.
